name: TCGDEX
tagline: Multilingual Pokémon TCG API for sets, cards, and series.
description: TCGDEX is a free and open multilingual Pokémon Trading Card Game API providing structured data on cards, sets, series, and related metadata for developers building tools, collectors apps, and game-related experiences.

auth.details: No authentication required; public open API endpoints.

use_cases: look up a Pokémon TCG card by ID or name
build a multilingual card search tool
